data:
熔炉的热量吸引着十里八荒几乎所有还活着的小动物，它们想尽办法溜进来，之后兴奋地四处搞破坏。
<@rolv.rem>场地中有激活后短暂持续造成法术伤害的<废热喷口></>

溶炉の熱は、この近辺で生き延びた小動物のほとんどを引き寄せてしまった。彼らは無理やり溶炉に潜り込み、気ままな破壊活動に勤しんでいる。
<@rolv.rem>起動するとしばらく術ダメージを与え続ける<廃熱噴出口>が出現</>

The furnace's heat attracts all kinds of critters from the wastes. They eagerly slip inside and gleefully wreak havoc.
<@rolv.rem><Waste Heat Vents> that deal Arts damage for brief periods when activated are present on the field</>
所有敌方单位的攻击力+20%，生命值+50%
下の「廃熱噴出口」のみが現れる
All enemy units have +20% ATK, +50% Max HP
More likely to be attacked; once defeated, drops 1 Plan
Creates Mark of Epoch in the surrounding area; allied units within the Mark of Epoch receive continuous Necrosis damage

Passive: Restores <@ba.vup>2</> SP upon being attacked
Activation Effect: Deals <@ba.vdown>200</> {arts} damage per second to all friendly and ground enemy units in range for <@ba.vup>10</> seconds, and additionally slows the Movement Speed of enemies by <@ba.vup>-70%</> and causes them to gain <@ba.vdown>1</> Energy
Gives +4 Originium Ingots when fully healed
